mix.no_fan: No ceiling-fan sound anywhere in the episode (Mohit; sfx_notes). l25 names the fan: nothing under it, no fan effect, ever.
rules: b1: l01 is off screen but close and dry, not distant (two metres): no reverb, no room send, no low-pass on Aditya. Powder and bed under him; everything cuts dead on 'आधी में' (set-up 2 is the same frame with no sound but the voice).
b1-b4: no music. Bed, paper, bed creak, feet, bolt, padlock, almirah, hinge only.
b3: the padlock knock is the loudest effect in the first half; leave about 0.3 s of bed alone after it before l04.

b5: lane bed hard in and hard out on the cuts. Billu (l08) dry and in the car. Mausi (l09, l10) is phone-processed on her voice take: band-pass about 300-3400 Hz, light saturation, wide enough that every consonant survives, fully voiced and warm, never whispered (library mix.phone_voice_fx, car/lane colour). No ring, no pickup, no call-end sound: the call is already running. Duck lane bed about 6 dB under l10 so the name is clear. Drone enters here at the edge of hearing.
b6-b8: room tone only plus the drone. Nothing under l13: bed down 3-4 dB and drone ducked hard for the whole line. No point effects in b6; the l16 padlock insert is silent (do not reuse the knock).
b8: sfx_photo_print on the l23 insert, under the voice.
b9: drone continues under l24 and the 2.0 s photograph hold; no effect on the photograph.
b10: crickets and bed out under l25; drone fades to nothing within the first half of l25. The 2.2 s hold on Kiran is near-silence (lamp-hum stretch at most).

b11: bed and music right down under l26 so it is fully clear (nothing under it but at most the lamp-hum stretch). Swell on the scar insert, dead cut at set-up 3; chooda click alone; cut to black and digital silence to the end of the file.
Shortening silences for length (D-018 rule 3): the cue placement survives shorter holds; mus_swell_reveal is trimmed from its head, never allowed to ring past its cut.
